lines.t: I used to fight every voice that opposed me
Tried to prove what I thought was right
Held my ground in my own understanding
Turned love into a silent fight
But something deeper put my heart back
Said let it go, don't take that road
Lay down the weight of being right
And carry mercy like a coat
Bless the ones who speak up
Send them love instead of fire
When they want you, don't return it
Lift them up a little higher
Pray for those who try to break you
Even when it cuts you through
There's a brighter way of living
Let that love remake you
I don't have to win the moment
I don't have to claim control
There's a freedom in releasing
Every judgment from my soul
No more shutting hearts out cold
No more drawing bitter lines
Compassion grows where pride once stood
In the spaces I resigned
Bless the ones who speak against you
Send them love instead of fire
When they want you, don't return it Lift them up a little higher
Pray for those who try to break you Even when it cuts you through
There's a greater way of living Let that love remake you
I won't answer hate with hatred I won't mirror what they do
There's a quiet strength in kindness That will always carry through
Even when I'm misunderstood Even when the pain feels true
I'll choose mercy over judgment That's the path I'm walking through
No more judging, no more hiding No more closing off my heart
Even in the disagreement
Love is where I choose to start
Bless the ones who speak against you
Let your grace be what they see
When they curse, respond with heaven
Set your spirit fully free
Pray for those who stand against you
Let forgiveness be your move
There's a higher way unfolding
And it's calling me and you
